info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Unit Trust Administration API
info.description: The Unit Trust Administration API serves to streamline the management of unit trust accounts, ensuring efficient operations for updating account details and configurations. This API allows authorized users to modify specific attributes of existing unit trust records dynamically. Typical consumers include financial institutions and asset management firms looking to enhance their operational efficiency in managing investor accounts. The functionality aims to facilitate timely adjustments to information, ultimately improving service delivery and compliance.
